posts.name: trudge
posts.cooked:
I'm confused by battles involving the Chairman outside of Rook City.  I mean, a big chunk of his power comes from having infiltrated almost every level of Rook City's infrastructure...

 

So, what happens when you fight him in Insula Primalis?  I picture a bunch of mobsters in a jungle, gawking around.  "Ah... boss?  'Zat a dinosaur?"

The Final Wasteland is similarly hilarious.  Realm of Discord?  Silver Gulch?  Imagining the Chairman's thugs standing around dumfounded in these places is comedy gold.

Have to agree on the "comedy gold", though.

TCP:

I think Chairman in the Block makes some sense. I imagine the battle is the Chairman's elaborate attempt to break out of prison.

 

We redid the Block once, to represent that the Chairman had taken it over, we redid guards to attack heroes or inmates, and inmates were on the heroes side.  Basically the Heroes show up at the block to interrogate or drop off a prisoner or something, and once inside are captured and find out what has happened, then have to break out of the block.
